title: California Roll
description: Crab stick, avocado, cucumber and Japanese mayonnaise in an inside-out roll.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Shred crab sticks or leave as slim batons, cut avocado and cucumber lengthwise, and pat cucumber dry.
Cover a rolling mat with food-safe wrap. Spread rice thinly across half-sheet nori and flip so rice faces the mat.
Lay down crab, avocado, cucumber and a narrow stripe of Kewpie. Roll firmly with the mat and shape evenly.
Coat the exterior in tobiko or sesame if desired, then slice eight pieces.
notes: For the outer coating, use either roe or sesame, not necessarily both.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
